- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER generated the highest revenue in TW at £3.0k, followed by PARTY BUNTING at £2.3k.
- WORLD WAR 2 GLIDERS ASSTD DESIGNS led unit sales in TW with 1,445 units, while VICTORIAN GLASS HANGING T-LIGHT achieved 739 units.
- PARTY BUNTING received the most orders in TW with 45 orders, compared to 38 orders for SPOTTY BUNTING.
- ORANGE TV TRAY TABLE showed exceptional WoW growth of 18,500% in revenue, while FAIRY TALE COTTAGE NIGHTLIGHT grew 7,792.3% WoW.
- LARGE RED RETROSPOT WINDMILL demonstrated the strongest YoY performance with revenue growth of 25,650.5% compared to LY.
- GUMBALL COAT RACK achieved 5,509.2% YoY revenue growth, significantly outpacing ORANGE TV TRAY TABLE's 4,167.1% YoY increase.
- BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME generated £1.7k revenue in TW while also showing 764.6% YoY growth.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER maintained consistent performance with £1.7k revenue in TW, 629 units sold, and 34 orders placed.
